Option1: "ناو او از درون و او معکوس - دلو آن از برون و او در گود (گودال)" Something about ship inside and reversed, heart outside and in a pit. Might be about inner/outer contradictions.

Option2: "قسمتی نیست که بر باد نرفت - رایتی نیست که معکوس نماند" Means "There is no part that hasn't gone with the wind; no opinion that remains reversed." Might be about impermanence, change.

Option3: "از خالف آمد عادت بطلب کام که من - کسب جمعیت از آن زلف پریشان کردم" Hard to parse. Might be about desire, habit, tangled hair.

Option4: "از فقیر است همه زر و حریر - هین (maybe) غنی زاده زکاتی ای فقیر" Means "All gold and silk are from the poor; oh wealthy-born, give alms, O poor?" Something about wealth disparity.

We need which one has different concept/message. Options 1-3 seem about inner/outer, change, desire. Option4 about poverty/wealth. Likely option4 is outlier.

Thus answer 4.
